VIRTUAL CARE. ANYTIME. ANYWHERE.

Benefits Navigator is a simple and trusted way to access U.S. board-certified doctors and pediatricians, 24/7/365, by phone or secure video chat, from home or on the go, within minutes. Benefits Navigator also provides virtual access to therapists, specialists, healthcare advocates, health coaches, and cost transparency & savings tools, right from your phone or tablet.

\*\*Benefits Navigator is the only platform that seamlessly integrates telehealth services together with your other benefits to deliver a comprehensive, all-in-one solution for all of your healthcare needs, becoming your new front door to your healthcare benefits.\*\*

Depending on your membership level, you may have access to:

TELEMEDICINE / ONLINE MEDICAL VISITS

Doctors can diagnose, treat, and prescribe (if medically necessary), for a wide range of common medical issues, including, but not limited to bronchitis, sinus & respiratory infections, sore throat, diarrhea, cold/flu, allergies, strep throat, urinary tract infections, pink eye, rashes, migraines, ear infections, and more.

MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES

We also offer online talk therapy and psychiatry visits for treatment and support for a wide variety of behavioral health issues, including but not limited to depression, anxiety, grief & loss, trauma & PTSD, relationship issues, stress, postpartum depression, bipolar disorder, and more.

HEALTH & WELLNESS COACHING

Our health and wellness coaches are trained to help with a wide range of health, wellness, and chronic conditions. We offer support for things such as weight loss, diabetes, high blood pressure, nutrition coaching, and more, helping you to live a healthier life.

HEALTHCARE ADVOCACY & CONCIERGE

Your “Personal Health Ally” can help you navigate through the complexities of the messy U.S. healthcare system and your insurance plan. Get help with common everyday needs like selecting the right providers, scheduling appointments, reviewing and negotiating medical bills, understanding and managing insurance claims, and more.

COST TRANSPARENCY & SAVINGS TOOLS

Save on your prescriptions with our pharmacy discount program. Have our team of experts review and negotiate your medical bills. Access to lower-cost healthcare services. And more right in the app.

Features & Benefits include:

Medical care within minutes; mental health sessions within as little as 24 hours

Digital benefits wallet to store and view all of your insurance ID cards

Savings & transparency tools

Private and secure

Family coverage

Skip the germ-filled waiting room

NOTE: You must have a company-sponsored membership to use Benefits Navigator. Some of the above services may not be available, depending on the plan level offered by your company. Check with your employer to see if you are eligible. Member verification and login are required.

We treat many patients each day with many different conditions, but you should not use AllyHealth if you are experiencing a medical emergency. Benefits Navigator may not be available in certain states and is subject to state regulations. Benefits Navigator is NOT an insurance product or company, and may not be able to substitute for traditional in-person care in every case for every condition. Benefits Navigator does not guarantee patients will receive a prescription, does not prescribe DEA-controlled substances, and may not prescribe non-therapeutic drugs and certain other drugs which may be harmful because of their potential for abuse.

[Skip to Main Content](https://www.nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/maternity/benefitnavigator.shtml#content) XLLGMDSMXS ## Dedicated Support for Mercer County Parents ![a woman in a hospital bed holding and smiling at her newborn baby](https://www.nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/assets/images/960x480/GettyImages-2135645274_960x480.jpg) We’re connecting Mercer County families who are expecting or have recently welcomed a new child—through birth, fostering, or adoption—with paid leave navigators. Navigators will guide parents through understanding paid family and medical leave benefits, help estimate eligibility, and assist with completing paid leave benefit applications. This extra assistance will be available until October 2026, in collaboration with the [Children's Home Society of New Jersey](https://chsofnj.org/paid-family-leave/) and [Trenton Health Team](https://trentonhealthteam.org/communitycare/). ### How can Navigators help? Paid leave can be a complex benefit to understand. Navigators help families learn about the program, answer questions, and apply. Navigators will help a parent: - Understand the benefit and how it works - See if you could be eligible - See if you are covered under [job protection](https://www.nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/job-protection-information/), which is separate - Gather the required information to apply - Provide guidance on talking to your healthcare provider - Provide guidance on talking to your employer - Complete the application - Follow up if your application needs additional information ### How can parents use paid leave benefits? Eligible families can use paid leave benefits to **replace up to 85% of their average weekly wages** (or up to $1081/week in 2025) while they take necessary work leave to care for themselves and their family. Birthing parents can use [disability benefits](https://www.nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/maternity/) to: - Manage their pregnancy - Recover from birth - Recover from complications, like postpartum depression All parents can use family leave benefits to: - [Bond with their newborn](https://www.nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/fli/index.shtml?open=newborns) - [Bond with an adopted or fostered child](https://www.nj.gov/labor/myleavebenefits/worker/fli/index.shtml?open=fostadopt) within first year of placement ### Who qualifies for navigator assistance? Parents in Mercer County with a growing family could participate in this pilot to learn more about paid leave benefits and whether they may be eligible. Parents may be: - Expecting a new child or recently delivered, or are bonding - Adopting/fostering a new child Navigators could help families planning to take leave, are currently on leave, or have recently taken leave. Navigators will help families assess if they’re likely eligible for wage replacement and if their job is protected. Generally speaking, parents need the following to be eligible for benefits: - Recently worked - Have a valid Social Security number - In the last five quarters, earned at least $15,500 in gross wages or earned at least $310 in gross wages for 20 weeks or more (in 2025) If you’re unsure if you meet the earning requirements, a navigator can help you see if you are possibly eligible. ### Who are navigators? For this pilot, a Paid Leave Navigator is a term to describe people in many different roles, like doulas, community health workers, and social workers, who are trained to help parents apply for NJ paid leave and navigate the process. ### Why are we doing this pilot? We want to learn if a navigator service can improve access to paid leave benefits for more families across Mercer County and eventually, across the state of New Jersey. We are starting small so we can learn and adapt! For more information about the pilot, email [pfml.outreach@dol.nj.gov](mailto:pfml.outreach@dol.nj.gov). ### Download a Navigator Pilot flyer | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | * * *

# Take advantage of all your VA benefits with VA Resource Navigator

Benefits & resources are a click or scan away

July 3, 2025

Office of National Center for Health Promotion and Disease Prevention

It’s important to understand—and access—all the VA benefits you’ve earned and deserve. The [VA Resource Navigator](http://www.prevention.va.gov/PCL/docs/NCP-PCL-Handout-VA-Resource-Navigator-508.pdf) can help.

The Navigator puts [VA resources](https://news.va.gov/?s=VA+resources) and program information at your fingertips through web links, phone numbers and QR codes.

Use the [VA Resource Navigator](https://www.prevention.va.gov/PCL/PCL-VA-Navigator.asp) to explore VA benefits and programs:

- Health care
- Disability
- Education and training
- Homelessness support and housing assistance
- Careers and employment
- Pension
- Family member, caregiver and survivor benefits
- Finding VA records
- Burial information
- More

The new, improved 2025 version of the Navigator reflects input from Veterans and VA staff. It includes a VA Records section, a VA Mobile Apps section, frequently searched terms, improved mental health and homelessness support content, and lots more.

Veterans say the Navigator is a helpful tool—whether you have recently transitioned out of the military or have been using VA services for a long time.

## Connecting with information and VA staff

The Navigator is easy to use. To learn more about each resource, just scan its QR code or click its link.

If you’d like to speak to a person, there’s a phone number for your convenience. You can also reach out to your [local VA](https://www.va.gov/find-locations/) or dial MyVA411: (800) 698-2411 for help.

[Learn more about the VA Resource Navigator](https://www.prevention.va.gov/PCL/PCL-VA-Navigator.asp).

Personalized pregnancy and parenting support


The My Pregnancy app helps you stay on top of your health throughout pregnancy and your baby’s first 2 years.

![](https://www.bluecrossnc.com/content/dam/bcbsnc/logos/my-pregnancy-bcbsnc.png)


What's the My Pregnancy app?

The My Pregnancy app is a progress tracker and knowledge source that goes where you go. Its enhanced, 2-way communication with experienced nurses lets you discuss your concerns to help you feel assured your pregnancy is progressing well.

And if you're not pregnant yet, the My Pregnancy app is full of resources to help you plan and learn.

At Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina (Blue Cross NC), you're more than a customer. My Pregnancy is simply one more way we show our unwavering commitment to every member's health.

To learn more, [watch this short video on YouTube⁠](https://youtu.be/NX6OesfGbdM).





Support for you and your baby



Whether this is your first child or your fourth, you deserve extra support. The My Pregnancy app – developed by board-certified obstetricians, nurse midwives, and medical experts with Wildflower Health – gives you the right support when you need it.



Message a nurse


Regular app use helps you learn about and identify potential risks to you and your baby.

When you have concerns, use your mobile phone to connect quickly and privately with a trained nurse.



Get the answers you need


Get information you can trust about pregnancy symptoms, breastfeeding, labor, and delivery.

You can also watch videos about your baby's weekly development and build a list of questions you want to ask your doctor at your next OB visit.



Key pregnancy features


You can find features to help you stay healthy, including:

- Pregnancy and postpartum guidance
- Week-by-week development milestones
- Due date calculator
- Blood pressure tracker
- Weight tracker



Key baby features


You can find weekly posts on safety, immunizations, mental health, and more, plus features for your baby’s first 2 years, including:

- Developmental milestone tracker
- Diaper tracker

- Feeding tracker
- Growth tracker





Download today



Download the My Pregnancy Blue Cross NC app for iOS and Android devices.

# Capital Health Maternity App

In This Section


### Sign Up for Our Maternity App!

Capital Health offers expecting parents helpful education through a convenient mobile app. It includes videos, information, and tools to support you at every stage of the journey into parenthood. You’ll have access to:

**Read, Watch, Learn:** Education for pregnancy, birth, breastfeeding, baby care and more.

**Multiple Languages:** Choose your language preference for learning.

**Support Tools:** Kick counter, contraction timer, personal journal, feeding log, immunization log, and other tools.

### Sign Up Is as Easy as 1-2-3

**Step 1: Register**

Register for the program by clicking the link below and following the instructions.

- [Register Here in English](https://legacy.bump2baby360.com/CapitalHealthMedicalCenterHopewell/WelcometotheCapitalHealthMaternityApp_423146_996)
- [Register Here in Spanish](https://legacy.bump2baby360.com/CapitalHealthMedicalCenterHopewell/WelcometotheCapitalHealthMaternityApp_423146_996?culture=es)

**Step 2: Check Your Email**

Once you have registered, you will receive an email invitation from [noreply@bump2baby360.com](mailto:noreply@bump2baby360.com).

**Step 3: Download and Login**

Follow the instructions in your email to download the app and use the provided username and password.

### Support

For general how-to questions, please reference the Bump2Baby360 Help Center. If you are having a technical issue or have identified a bug while registering or using the app, please email [ChildBirthEd@capitalhealth.org](mailto:ChildBirthEd@capitalhealth.org) and our team can send it to Baby360 to investigate and resolve the issue.

_**Disclaimer:** The information in Bump2Baby360 App is NOT intended to take the place of a health care provider or any information that your health care provider has discussed with you about your own personal health. It is imperative and advised that you find care and work with your health care provider to keep yourself healthy and safe. Always call your health care provider with any questions you may have. By creating an account in Bump2Baby360, you have verified that you have read and agree to this disclaimer._
